fixes: Member sizes vs sheet-vs-lava-glass #1 (34 m = ~395 px, ~11.6 px/m): concept mullion faces read ~0.5 m, end posts ~0.9 m, head beam ~0.9-1.0 m, sill/plinth ~1.0-1.2 m. sheet_front seed 2 measures ~0.35 m mullions, ~0.7 m end posts, ~0.6 m head, ~0.6 m sill. Raise the mullion face to 0.42-0.48 m on the 12 m wall (keep the H/12 thin-out), end posts to 0.9-1.0 m, head_h to 0.075*H (0.9 m at 12 m), and sill_h to 0.9-1.1 m on walls of 8 m or more.

Sill: the concept sill is a heavy coursed plinth, dark block masonry under a bronze nosing, and reads as a separate band. Here it reads as a thin dark strip. Split the sill into a 0.7 m iron/basalt block course with vertical joints every 1.2-1.6 m (0.02 m recessed seams) under a 0.2 m bronze nosing that projects 0.15 m past the mullion face. Keep the course and the nosing as two bands at LOD2.

Mullion capitals and bases at hero distance: every concept mullion has a visible stepped shoe at the sill and a bracket capital under the head, about 1.5x the face width and 0.5-0.7 m tall. In the canonical the mullions run into the sill and head with no visible joint. Put shoes and capitals on every mullion, not only the major posts: shoe 0.6 m tall at 1.4x face width, capital 0.5 m at 1.5x. Keep them at LOD1-2 as one box each.

Front-face profile reads flat: against the lava the mullions are flat black strips with no edge highlight, while the concept frames catch warm rim light on chamfered faces. Add a 0.03-0.04 m chamfer or a bead on the outer face edges of mullions, posts and head (LOD0-1) so the lava glow picks them out, and make the 'box' shadow groove at least 0.06 m wide and 0.03 m deep so it reads at 15-20 m.

Seed variation: seeds 2 and 3 differ only by one clerestory bar and bay count 9/9. Seeds 1-3 are near twins in silhouette, and head style (cornice/corbel) does not show from the front. Make the head style read from the front: cornice gets a 0.25 m stepped overhang, corbel gets visible brackets 0.35 m deep over each mullion. Let 'centre' rhythm come up in one of the three review seeds so a wide middle bay (1.4-1.6x) shows.

Corridor slot size (w 1.4 m, sizes.png first item): the end posts and head eat about half the width, so it reads as a cabinet, not a window. On W < 2.6 m cap the end posts at 0.12*W each and head_h at 0.3 m, so the glass is at least 70% of the width.
library_issues: bronze: at default lighting (sheet.jpg, sizes.png) it reads as bright orange copper with a blotchy, burl-wood-like streak pattern, not near-black dark bronze with warm highlights. The scale=10 override still shows streaks on the posts. The library albedo and pattern need to go darker and finer.
lava_glass goes milky under direct light (seed 3 right-hand bays, LOD0-2 and phone LOD2). Known library issue, noted again.
lava_glass shows almost no surface reflection in the canonical (concept 13 and 04 show interior lanterns reflected on the glass). Raise the specular / lower the roughness of the glass front layer.
summary: Reads as the concept's mullioned lava wall, and the LOD chain keeps the grid down to LOD3 (74-80 tris). Against the sheet's scale bar every frame member is about 60-70% too thin, the heavy sill and head do not read as heavy, and mullion shoes and capitals are missing on most mullions, so at hero distance the frame is flat black strips. Seeds differ only slightly. Bronze reads as orange, streaky copper, which is a library problem.
